title.zh: 实时音视频轨道自愈与真实设备状态
title.en: Realtime media track recovery and truthful device status

purpose.zh: 修复SmartLingo.net中远端摄像头或麦克风订阅卡住，以及本机设备图标与实际媒体轨道不同步的问题。
purpose.en: Fix stuck remote camera or microphone subscriptions in SmartLingo.net and keep local device controls synchronized with actual media tracks.

zh: 音频与视频订阅独立恢复，持续缺轨 6 秒后只重建失效接收器。
麦克风、摄像头和扬声器以灰、橙、绿显示关闭、等待确认和真实工作状态。
本机每 2 秒检查真实发布轨道；设备中断时同步关闭并允许用户重连。
en: Recover audio and video subscriptions independently, rebuilding only a missing receiver after a sustained six-second gap.
Show microphone, camera and speaker as gray, orange or green for off, awaiting confirmation or actually working.
Check real local publishing tracks every two seconds; sync interrupted devices off and allow a clean reconnect.
SmartLingo.net language classrooms and live courses

zh: 订阅成功后才缓存参与者，并在真实轨道缺失时执行单媒体取消订阅和重新订阅。
串行执行设备按钮操作，避免快速点击产生交错状态；Safari 添加第二个设备时以两条已批准轨道重新连接。
扬声器绿色状态由 HTML 媒体元素实际播放事件确认。
en: Cache participants only after subscription succeeds and rebuild one media kind when its real track remains absent.
Serialize device operations and reconnect with both approved tracks when Safari adds a second device.
Confirm the green speaker state from actual HTML media playing events.

zh: 辅助模块单元测试、完整 TypeScript 检查、零警告 lint、完整自动测试和生产构建。
按用户要求不执行多人实时浏览器测试。
en: Helper unit tests, complete TypeScript checks, zero-warning lint, full automated tests and production build.
Per the user request, no multi-user realtime browser test was run.

zh: 实体设备、浏览器权限切换及多人网络抖动场景留待实际会议运行观察。
en: Physical-device, browser-permission and multi-participant network-handoff scenarios remain for live operational observation.

zh: 保留 SmartLingo.net 的品牌、业务数据、权限和支付逻辑，仅适配现有实时会议组件。
en: Preserve SmartLingo.net branding, business data, permissions and payment logic while adapting its existing realtime meeting component.

rollback.zh: 回退至上一成功的 Cloudflare 部署；不涉及数据迁移。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare deployment; no data migration is involved.
